description:
Markdown is the largest non-Input leaf (~350 lines core +
inline/lexer/render/stream submodules). Today it returns
`[binary()]`; under VDom it returns a VFlow of VText leaves with
ANSI styling already baked in via `%VText{style: …}`.

Stream submodule must be reviewed: it currently emits incremental
output during streaming. With VDom + memoization, the streaming
contract becomes "props change → memo key changes → subtree
repaints". Confirm that incremental rendering performance is at
least matched (telemetry: nodes_visited / paint duration per delta).

Acceptance: existing markdown rendering tests stay green; ANSI byte
sequences identical to today's output for representative fixtures.
title: Convert Markdown subsystem (markdown.ex + markdown/{inline,lexer,render,stream})
